cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.

mechanism: A uses expert cash-close distinctions to treat a worker departure as requiring A explicit release, extending that authority to the waiting transport.
confusable: D26 invents another favor to delay departure; D50 specifically asserts that departure itself is a privilege only A may authorise.
comparison: Coffee alternative imposes social-session closure without legitimate managerial role; shop alternative exaggerates a real closing procedure into control over the taxi.
seedUse: Shut shop, counted till, waiting daughter and taxi derive from D50-a; S03 adds counted-versus-reconciled and release-channel corrections.
